description: Create a transcription from a link to a video or recording (YouTube, Google Drive, Dropbox and others; the recording is transcribed, never downloaded). Starts at once and uses the account's minutes. Returns the transcription with its id; poll get_transcription until status is done, then read get_transcript.

captions.description: YouTube only: use the video's own captions when they fit; uses no minutes.

diarization.description: Label speakers (default true; not every language supports it).

language.description: "auto", or one of the codes the API lists in openapi.json — a full tag such as en-US, pt-BR or es-MX, never "en". Omit for automatic detection.

name: transcribe_link
title: Transcribe a link
